previous_last_sync.summary: Audited 5 commits. Three change user-facing behavior (workshop flood clear, Hella OPS+T sensor, board-fixed TunerStudio settings) and need documentation; the Core8 LED pin fix and MC33816 SPI fix are hardware/behavior corrections already covered by the changelog and need no end-user doc change beyond what exists.

decisions.rationale: Adds a new user-selectable flood-clear mode in TunerStudio Advanced Cranking, changes the flood-clear threshold to 90% driver throttle intent, and makes cranking priming respect driver throttle intent. Users need to know how the two modes behave and when the latch releases.
evidence: firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: new bit isCylinderCleanupLatching,"Service / Workshop","Roadside" with help text
firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini: field = "Flood clear mode", isCylinderCleanupLatching, {isCylinderCleanupEnabled}
firmware/controllers/limp_manager.cpp: updateCutsFloodClear latch logic, m_floodClearLatched
firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/prime_injection.cpp: priming now uses SensorType::DriverThrottleIntent
firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: isCylinderCleanupEnabled help changed to 90% driver throttle intent

decisions.rationale: Adds support for a new combined digital oil pressure/temperature sensor with a new TunerStudio input field, provider-priority rules, DTC behavior, and a documented validation caveat. Users need configuration and behavior guidance.
evidence: firmware/controllers/sensors/hella_opst.md: operator notes for Hella OPS+T 6PR 010 378-207
firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: new brain_input_pin_e hellaOpsTInput
firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini: field = "Hella OPS+T input", hellaOpsTInput in oil pressure dialog
firmware/controllers/sensors/sensor_checker.cpp: UnexpectedCode::Inconsistent mapped for OilPressure/OilTemperature
firmware/controllers/sensors/hella_opst.cpp: BARO subtraction, 500 ms timeout, provider registration only when channel unclaimed

decisions.rationale: Board-level LED pin correction for Core8 v2.3/v2.4. It changes which physical pin drives the critical error LED but introduces no new user setting or workflow; the changelog entry already records it. No end-user documentation change is required.
evidence: firmware/config/boards/core8/board.mk: DDEFS += -DLED_CRITICAL_ERROR_BRAIN_PIN=Gpio::G11
firmware/config/boards/core8/board_configuration.cpp: comment corrected to PG11
firmware/CHANGELOG.md: Core8 v2.3/v2.4 critical error LED now uses PG11

decisions.rationale: Changes TunerStudio behavior users will see: board-fixed settings become read-only/greyed out and are protected during tune import, with conditional (revision-dependent) settings using controllerPriority and requiring a connected ECU. This needs user-facing explanation of what is locked and why.
evidence: firmware/config/boards/tunerstudio-protection.md: documents ts_readonly_ declarations, readOnly vs controllerPriority, import/offline limits
java_tools/configuration_definition/src/main/java/com/rusefi/newparse/outputs/TsConfigProtection.java: emits readOnly/controllerPriority and rewrites field enable expressions
firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini: [ConstantsExtensions] CONFIG_READ_ONLY marker
firmware/config/boards/*/prepend.txt: many new ts_readonly_* declarations across boards

decisions.rationale: Removes a hard-coded SPI3 assignment so the configured MC33816 SPI bus is honored. This is a bug fix with no new user setting or workflow; the changelog entry already records it and no end-user doc change is needed.
evidence: firmware/hw_layer/mc33816.cpp: removed engineConfiguration->mc33816spiDevice = SPI_DEVICE_3
firmware/hw_layer/mc33816.cpp: driver = getSpiDevice(engineConfiguration->mc33816spiDevice) now uses configured value
firmware/CHANGELOG.md: Configured MC33816 SPI selection is now honored

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for USB mass-storage decoupling. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/10-Software/USB-Mass-Storage.md (not claimed public here). The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Makes USB mass storage independently selectable from SD-card logging, including INI-only single-LUN builds, so board and operator behavior needs a guide.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): USB mass storage can be enabled independently of SD-card file logging, allowing INI-only MSD builds without FatFs.

[firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/mass_storage_init.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/mass_storage_init.cpp): EFI_USB_MSD selects an INI-only LUN without SD support and retains the existing two-LUN layout when logging is present.
guide target: docs/10-Software/USB-Mass-Storage.md (pending separate docs PR; not claimed public)

decisions.rationale: Integration merge for original PR #6 adds no impact beyond 17a70bec; the supplied range records this merge as the USB event closure and no second feature delta.
